brand.name: Suhbah
brand.sector: Shared worship tracker app for Muslims

sentence.en: Two people, one arc. Log your prayers and watch your day fill up together.

set.name: Two Gardens
set.mechanism: Two people, two colours, one arc: the mark is the app's own together arc, and the two halves are the only saturated colours on a clean white ground.
set.expression_move: The two-colour arc is the only loud thing; everything else is ink on white.
set.differs_by: Muslim Pro, Athan and Pillars lead with a single green or teal. Suhbah keeps a green half so it still reads as a Muslim app, and adds a crimson half that none of them use: the second person.

logo.concept: The together arc from the Today screen, drawn as three strokes split into two halves.

rationale.claim: The arc mark and both typefaces are kept from the app as the founder approved them; only the colours change between sets.
Green conforms to the category while the crimson half is unshared among the named competitors.

findings.message: light: success #087868 and primary #0b7d5e are only CIEDE2000 5.3 apart; users may read one as the other

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.08, same hue

findings.message: #0b7d5e and #c7224f are both saturated (C* 38/66) with almost equal lightness (Delta L* 2.4); edges between them vibrate and text on either is unreadable

suggested_fix.how: darken by OKLCH L -0.10, same hue

findings.message: #1d9673 and #ef7185 are both saturated (C* 42/52) with almost equal lightness (Delta L* 7.8); edges between them vibrate and text on either is unreadable

findings.message: brand and action colours span only Delta L* 2.4; without a clear light/dark step between them the palette reads flat (lightness contrast is the strongest harmony predictor, O'Donovan 2011)

suggested_fix.how: move the accent (not a locked brand colour) at least 25 L* away from the primary

findings.message: light: ext-1 #e9a21b is 2.18:1 on the light background #ffffff; as a stripe, chart series or thin line it needs 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)

suggested_fix.how: use ext-1-600 for stripes, chart series and thin lines

findings.message: light: border #e3e7e5 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #36453f on background #07120e is 1.89:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#0b7d5e sits at the sRGB gamut edge (98% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
#c7224f sits at the sRGB gamut edge (91% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
#0b7d5e and #c7224f differ by only Delta L* 2.4; side by side in a logo they merge in greyscale/one-colour print
Ou-Luo two-colour model scores #0b7d5e + #c7224f at -0.99 (negative = less harmonious on a grey CRT test, no context): model signal only; the pairing table in references/pairing.md takes precedence
